notes: The two compound units are decided on opposite sides of the same test and both stay aligned: whereunto spells both tokens (rule 35), and mightily spells one, might- answering to dynamei (rules 94, 39). Rule 34's pleonastic reading is not available, since dynamis alone glosses power rather than mightily.
